items.summary: Kathmandu, September 21 Infrastructure Development Minister Sunil Lamsal has said that around Rs 100 billion is needed for post-disaster reconstruction and infrastructure management following the Bhotekoshi disaster. items.title: 39 dead, 439 missing at Upper Trishuli-1 Hydropower Project
items.summary: Kathmandu, September 21 Thirty-nine people working at the 216 MW Upper Trishuli-1 Hydropower Project in Rasuwa have been found dead, while 439 others remain missing following the devastating flood in the Bhotekoshi River on August 26. items.title: Balendra Shah’s UN appearance draws diplomatic interest in New York
items.summary: Nepal’s prime minister is set to address the General Assembly on climate justice, the Bhotekoshi floods and the concerns of mountain countries.

items.title: What the Bhotekoshi flood revealed about Nepal’s health system
items.summary: The emergency phase of the flood has largely been contained, but the most demanding work still lies ahead.

items.title: The nurse who wanted to heal Rasuwa
items.summary: Pratima Tamang Lama was a nurse, community worker, and ambitious local leader who dreamed of becoming Nepal’s health minister. The Bhotekoshi flood cut those dreams short.

items.title: Welcome to a terrifying new climate era
items.summary: The Bhotekoshi crisis must be recognised as a clear signal that we have entered a new era in our rapidly warming world.
